ItemID: NA; Title: Revolver; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Classic rock fits my recent listening, but I would pass this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of Otis Redding; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The soulful vocals appeal to the blues and soul mood suggested by Memphis and Old Sock; this is my pick today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Best of the Grateful Dead; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Their rootsy rock feels relevant, but I am not interested enough to choose this collection today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Traveller; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its country and blues sound could suit my interest in Blown Away, but I would leave it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Chronicle: 20 Greatest 1976; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Creedence's bluesy rock suits my tastes, but I would choose Otis Redding first.
ItemID: NA; Title: Greatest Hits: 50 Big Ones; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The Beach Boys' harmony-focused pop is not what I am seeking right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Electric Light Orchestra: Out of the Blue - Live at Wembley; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues and roots music today than orchestral rock.
ItemID: NA; Title: Something New The U.S. Album; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Early Beatles material has some appeal, but this particular album does not prompt me to choose it today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Definitive Collection; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist name, I cannot tell whether this collection interests me.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Best of Four Tops: 20th Century Masters The Millennium Collection; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The soul sound appeals, but I would only pick the Otis Redding collection this time.
